def make_pair(width, rows):
    g=[[3]*width for _ in range(11)]
    for r, cols in rows.items():
        for c in cols: g[r][c]=1
    expected=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r, cols in rows.items():
        for a,b in zip(cols,cols[1:]):
            if b-a==2: expected[r][a+1]=2
    return g, expected
